qualitative.variation_notes: Length varies widely, from one-line reactions and reply-style quips to long multi-paragraph explainers and daily recaps. Register ranges from playful and self-deprecating to structured and analytical, sometimes within the same donor. Script varies too: most posts are simplified Chinese, one donor writes in traditional Chinese, and some posts are bilingual. Openings are mostly claim-led, with questions, contrasts and ticker- or date-led lines used less often. Topic mix spans US equities, A-shares/HK, crypto and AI tooling, and posts are spread fairly evenly across mechanism explainers, hot takes, data takes and view relays.
qualitative.judgment_style: Generally assertive in tone, but the views are often hedged with conditional phrasing, tentative words like 'possibly' or 'remains to be seen', or explicit levels and signals to watch. Data is used mainly to support a narrative or call rather than presented neutrally.
